nodes.title: Note: MiniMax Music 3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax Music 3

A music generation model by MiniMax that creates complete songs up to 5 minutes long with stable structure and high audio quality. Two inputs drive it: **Caption** (structured music description: style, mood, vocals, arrangement) and **Lyrics** (with `[intro]` `[verse]` `[chorus]` `[bridge]` `[outro]` tags controlling song structure).

### Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| Caption | Music description. Write it in three sections — Global Metadata → Vocal Details → Arrangement. The more specific, the closer the result. |
| Lyrics | Song lyrics + section tags. Tags are the only executable structural instructions; the lyric text itself only conveys mood. |
| max_duration | Target song length in seconds (default 120 = 2 minutes; the model supports up to ~300 s / 5 minutes). Longer songs take more time and VRAM. |
| seed | Random seed for the generation. Keep it fixed to reproduce the same song; change it to get a different take. |
| Model files | diffusion model / text encoder / VAE.|
| Tiled decode | Decode the audio VAE in overlapping tiles to drastically cut VRAM usage — helpful for long songs on low-VRAM GPUs. Slightly slower, with a small risk of seams at tile boundaries; turn it off on high-VRAM GPUs for the best quality. |

### Prompt Writing Guide

You can find an official [Music Caption Rewriter Skill here](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-Music3)

nodes.title: Caption (NovA Text)
widgets_values:
Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 182. key is F, and scale is major. Happy Hardcore / Electronic Pop.
Global Emotional Progression: The track opens with a dreamy, atmospheric tension that quickly accelerates into a high-energy, euphoric release. The verses maintain a sense of urgent anticipation, which explodes into frantic, joyous choruses characterized by rapid rhythmic density. A brief, ethereal breakdown provides a momentary emotional respite before the energy surges back for a final, climactic conclusion that fades with lingering optimism.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: High-speed night driving, rhythm game sequences, anime opening themes, or energetic festival dance floors under strobe lights.
Sonics & Production Profile: The soundstage is exceptionally wide and bright, dominated by crisp, piercing high-frequency synthesizers and a tightly compressed, punchy low end. The production aesthetic is polished and hyper-compressed, maximizing loudness and impact while maintaining clarity across the dense frequency spectrum.

Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: Singer A French (Female). The vocalist possesses a bright, clear, high pitch, and youthful soprano timbre that cuts through the dense instrumental mix with precision.
Vocal Style: The performance begins with a soft, breathy delivery in the verses, creating an intimate contrast to the fast tempo. As the song progresses into the choruses, the style shifts to a powerful, belted projection with sustained notes, conveying urgency and emotional intensity. The bridge features a more layered, chant-like repetition that builds hypnotic momentum.
Harmony/Backing Vocals: Multi-tracked self-harmonies appear prominently in the choruses, creating a thick, choral texture that reinforces the main melody. In the bridge, stacked vocal layers create a swelling, anthem-like effect before resolving back to the single lead line for the final chorus.
Vocal FX: The vocals are treated with moderate reverb and delay to sit within the expansive synth landscape. Subtle pitch-correction is evident, lending a modern, polished sheen. During the breakdown, the vocal is drenched in heavier reverb and slight filtering to enhance the dreamlike atmosphere before the dry, upfront return in the final drop.

Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: A supersaw lead synthesizer carries the main melodic hook, entering forcefully at the first chorus and defining the track's high-energy identity throughout the drops.
Secondary: An arpeggiated synth line provides constant motion in the verses, while a deep, side-chained sub-bass anchors the rhythm during the choruses. A clean electric piano appears briefly in the intro and bridge to soften the texture before the heavy synths return.
Groove & Foundation Progression: The rhythm section is driven by a relentless four-on-the-floor kick drum pattern typical of the genre, accompanied by rapid, rolling hi-hats and sharp snare hits on beats 2 and 4. The percussion intensifies during the choruses with added crash cymbals and off-beat open hats, creating a sense of forward propulsion. The bridge strips back the drums to a minimal pulse, allowing the bass to swell before the full beat crashes back in for the finale.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: White noise risers and pitch-bent synth sweeps serve as critical transitional elements leading into each chorus. Atmospheric pad swells fill the background during the verses, while glitchy digital stutters and reverse cymbal effects accentuate the ends of phrases. The outro utilizes a low-pass filter sweep to gradually mute the high frequencies, leaving only the fading vocal echo and a soft synth tail.
